'''Chasuka''' was an edible [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was available as [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Pieces of chasuka greens often became stuck in the [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] of those who ate them. Chasuka was a favorite food of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], who was better known as Doc.<ref name="Healthy teeth" />

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Just wanted you to know I deliberately left that piece of chasuka greens stuck in my teeth the other day.|Part of Doc's message|<ref name="Healthy teeth" />}}
Chasuka is first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], in the message "Healthy teeth" from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class's companion character Doc. Only [[Gender/Legends|female]] players who are pursuing a romance with Doc will receive the message.<ref name="Healthy teeth" />
